name: Livo (Italy)
description: White field with a black diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Livo (a black winged serpent on white).
history: Municipal flag of Livo, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.
